description: MLCN 24-feature schema: the CIC-IDS2017 (CICFlowMeter) columns the XGBoost model was trained on, derived from Module 2 PacketMetadata and Module 3 Flow. Times are microseconds, rates per second, lengths are payload bytes.

direction_conventions.forward: Same orientation as the first packet observed in the flow.
direction_conventions.backward: Opposite orientation from the forward direction.
direction_conventions.down_up_ratio: floor(reverse_packet_count / forward_packet_count), 0.0 when there are no forward packets.

features.formula: last packet timestamp - first packet timestamp, integer microseconds

edge_case_rules.zero_duration_flow: 0 when all packets share one timestamp
edge_case_rules.negative_clock_skew: clamp to 0 if computed duration is negative

cicflowmeter_compatibility.notes: CICFlowMeter flow duration in microseconds.

features.formula: count of packets with the first packet's orientation

cicflowmeter_compatibility.notes: Forward = direction of the first captured packet.

features.formula: count of packets with the opposite orientation

cicflowmeter_compatibility.notes: CIC backward packet count.

features.formula: sum of forward transport payload bytes (Ethernet padding included)

cicflowmeter_compatibility.notes: CIC counts TCP/UDP payload bytes, not wire length.

features.formula: sum of backward transport payload bytes (Ethernet padding included)

cicflowmeter_compatibility.notes: CIC counts TCP/UDP payload bytes, not wire length.

features.formula: Fwd Packets Length Total / Total Fwd Packets

cicflowmeter_compatibility.notes: Mean forward payload length.

features.formula: Bwd Packets Length Total / Total Backward Packets

cicflowmeter_compatibility.notes: Mean backward payload length.

features.formula: total payload bytes / (Flow Duration / 1e6)

cicflowmeter_compatibility.notes: Per second although durations are microseconds.

features.formula: packet_count / (Flow Duration / 1e6)

cicflowmeter_compatibility.notes: Per second although durations are microseconds.

features.formula: mean of consecutive packet timestamp gaps, microseconds

cicflowmeter_compatibility.notes: Mean inter-arrival time across all flow packets.

features.formula: sample std (ddof=1) of consecutive packet gaps, microseconds

edge_case_rules.few_intervals: 0.0 when fewer than 2 inter-arrival intervals exist

cicflowmeter_compatibility.notes: Sample standard deviation of flow inter-arrival times.

features.formula: mean gap between consecutive forward packets, microseconds

edge_case_rules.one_forward_packet: 0.0 when fewer than 2 forward packets exist

cicflowmeter_compatibility.notes: Mean forward-direction inter-arrival time.

features.formula: mean gap between consecutive backward packets, microseconds

edge_case_rules.one_backward_packet: 0.0 when fewer than 2 reverse packets exist

cicflowmeter_compatibility.notes: Mean backward-direction inter-arrival time.

features.formula: mean of [first payload] + every payload (n + 1 values)

cicflowmeter_compatibility.notes: CICFlowMeter adds the first packet's payload twice.

features.formula: sample std (ddof=1) of [first payload] + every payload

cicflowmeter_compatibility.notes: Computed over the same n + 1 values as Packet Length Mean.

features.formula: 1 if the first packet is TCP and has flag 'R', else 0

edge_case_rules.later_packets: flags of packets after the first are ignored

cicflowmeter_compatibility.notes: CIC-IDS2017 flag columns are binary first-packet bits written into permuted columns; this column carries the 'R' bit (verified on training rows).

features.formula: 1 if the first packet is TCP and has flag 'P', else 0

edge_case_rules.later_packets: flags of packets after the first are ignored

cicflowmeter_compatibility.notes: CIC-IDS2017 flag columns are binary first-packet bits written into permuted columns; this column carries the 'P' bit (verified on training rows).

features.formula: 1 if the first packet is TCP and has flag 'C', else 0

edge_case_rules.later_packets: flags of packets after the first are ignored

cicflowmeter_compatibility.notes: CIC-IDS2017 flag columns are binary first-packet bits written into permuted columns; this column carries the 'C' bit (verified on training rows).

features.formula: 1 if the first packet is TCP and has flag 'S', else 0

edge_case_rules.later_packets: flags of packets after the first are ignored

cicflowmeter_compatibility.notes: CIC-IDS2017 flag columns are binary first-packet bits written into permuted columns; this column carries the 'S' bit (verified on training rows).

features.formula: 1 if the first packet is TCP and has flag 'A', else 0

edge_case_rules.later_packets: flags of packets after the first are ignored

cicflowmeter_compatibility.notes: CIC-IDS2017 flag columns are binary first-packet bits written into permuted columns; this column carries the 'A' bit (verified on training rows).

features.formula: 1 if the first packet is TCP and has flag 'F', else 0

edge_case_rules.later_packets: flags of packets after the first are ignored

cicflowmeter_compatibility.notes: CIC-IDS2017 flag columns are binary first-packet bits written into permuted columns; this column carries the 'F' bit (verified on training rows).

features.formula: floor(Total Backward Packets / Total Fwd Packets)

cicflowmeter_compatibility.notes: CICFlowMeter integer division backward / forward.

features.formula: mean active span recorded when a gap > 5 s starts an idle period, microseconds; the trailing active span is never recorded

edge_case_rules.no_idle_gap: 0.0 when no gap exceeds the activity timeout
edge_case_rules.closing_fin: the FIN packet that closed the flow does not update activity

cicflowmeter_compatibility.notes: CICFlowMeter 5 s activity timeout.

features.formula: mean gap > 5 s between packets, microseconds

edge_case_rules.no_idle_gap: 0.0 when no gap exceeds the activity timeout
edge_case_rules.closing_fin: the FIN packet that closed the flow does not update activity

cicflowmeter_compatibility.notes: CICFlowMeter 5 s activity timeout.

removed_or_rejected_candidates.reason: Near-duplicate of Packet Length Mean (same payload sum; n instead of n + 1 values). The trained model uses only Packet Length Mean.
